name: srckube-reporting-service
description: WP-040 — Reporting & Analytics read-model service. Read-only: computes materialized chart-ready aggregates (coverage, pass-rate trend, defect summary, plan progress, release readiness, tester workload) from other services' data over HTTP, on a node-cron schedule plus an on-demand refresh endpoint. Never writes to another service's database. Built on @srckube/service-core.
